headline: Watch dashboard: every lane's live stream now sits in its own row
lede: The QA·STUDIO live pane was opening beside QA·MBP because tmux shifts pane indices when a split lands first. watch.sh now captures every pane's id at creation and targets ids only — and BUILDER·B and QA·MINI got live panes of their own with dedicated token taps.

notes.text: Root cause of #1356: tmux inserts a split pane right after its target, so the hardcoded 0.4 index named QA·MBP once live-builder's split had shifted every row. Captured pane ids replace all index targeting.

watchcheck grew row-adjacency gates: every LIVE pane must share its lane's row (same top, further right), checked from one geometry snapshot. Mutant proof: the old index target turns exactly the LIVE-STUDIO gate red.
BUILDER·B (:8012) and QA·MINI (:8013, via the mini tunnel with its own key) each get a tap + live pane; plists self-install merge=install, providers clone at runtime so keys stay local.
Slot a's sleepwatch v5 PR #1419 is still open on the board despite shipping notes — next lane should finish or rebase it.
